title: Docly — Shared With You
objective: Documents are shared with people by email, and you accept the ones addressed to you. Gain access to a document that was shared with someone else.

verifier.condition: A share is accepted by an account whose email differs from the recipient the share was sent to.

weakness: The accept endpoint finds a share by its sequential id and grants access to whoever is signed in, without verifying that the share was addressed to that account's email; only the pending list is filtered by recipient.
seededData: Users alice, dana, ben, tess. Documents d-901 and d-902 (tess) and d-903 (ben), with pending shares sh-2041 (to dana), sh-2042 (to ben) and sh-2043 (to alice). In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: Look at how shares are identified. Compare the ids you can see with what you might be able to guess.
The pending list only shows your shares. Does accepting one check the same thing?
Accept a share id that is not in your list, then open the document it points to.
burpNotes: Accept your own pending share with Burp running and look at exactly what identifies the share in the request.
